review_candidates.title: Account Manager
review_candidates.description: GlobalConnect søger en sælger med erfaring i opsøgende salg, der har lyst til at blive Account Manager hos én af de førende virksomheder på det danske fibermarked. Sammen med GlobalConnect tager du ansvar for Danmarks digitale motorvej, og med +230.000 km fiberkabler i hele Norden er der praktisk talt ikke den virksomhed, GlobalConnect ikke kan forsyne med hurtig og sikker datakommunikation. GlobalConnect er Nordens største udbyder af fiber og har mere end 1.800 ansatte. Du arbejder med base fra GlobalConnects kontor i Stilling, men selvfølgelig primært ude hos kunderne. Du vil arbejde med en stor portefølje af virksomheder i Vestdanmark og derfor have to dage om ugen hos potentielle og på sigt etablerede kunder. Alle virksomheder i din portefølje af prospects i SMB-segmentet har mellem 50 og 249 ansatte. Dine Arbejdsopgaver Du kontakter potentielle nye kunder i din portefølje af virksomheder. Du besøger kunderne og taler IT set-up og netværksløsninger med dem. I forhold til deres behov formidler du det løsningsorienterede salg mod kunden. Du bruger dine erfaringer med det behovsafdækkende løsningssalg og kan bringe relevante specialister i spil undervejs; men det er dig der løfter salget i mål. Vi Tilbyder Attraktiv lønpakke + pension Mulighed for at blive rigtig dygtig på markedet og udvikle dig internt Et team med stort engagement og godt samarbejde Grundig oplæring Personaleforening og god frokostordning GlobalConnect tilbyder dig et job i en professionel og vækstorienteret virksomhed, hvor der aldrig er langt fra tanke til handling. Hos GlobalConnect arbejder vi resultatorienteret og husker altid at fejre succeserne. Om GlobalConnect GlobalConnect er den førende leverandør af fiberbaseret datakommunikation og datacentre i Nordeuropa. Vores mission er enkel: Vi gør visioner til virkelighed ved at udvikle samfundet gennem gode forbindelser. Vores +250.000 kilometer fibernetværk og +35.000 m2 sikre datacentre er udgangspunktet for det næste skridt på vores kunders digitale rejse. Derudover får kunderne adgang til markedsledende løsninger inden for netværk, IT-sikkerhed, housing, co-location og datakommunikation. I dag er vi mere end 1.800 medarbejdere i Danmark, Norge, Sverige, Finland og Tyskland. Sammen genererer vi en omsætning på mere end 500 millioner € ved at levere løsninger til alle typer og størrelser af private og offentlige virksomheder. Opstart ønskes hurtigst muligt, ansøgninger behandles løbende og vi ansætter, så snart den rette kandidat er fundet. Din Profil Du er en hunterprofil, som har erfaring med B2B salg og er i stand til at booke dine egne møder over telefonen og ligeledes at tage ud til kunderne og forhandle aftaler på plads. Du har med fordel erfaring fra branchen. Du motiveres af at arbejde med potentielle kunder på strategisk niveau og synes at komplekst løsningssalg er sjovt. Du skaber let relationer på alle niveauer i en organisation, såvel hos kunden som internt. Formulerer dig godt på både dansk og engelsk. About Us GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences. We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

This is an entry-level role, but we are specifically looking for someone who already builds things independently. You might have created a website, app, automation, data tool or another personal project using Claude Code, Codex, Lovable, Replit or similar tools. You do not need professional software-development experience. You do need to show us something you have built, explain how you approached it and demonstrate that you can use AI to solve problems rather than only generate answers. Roles & Responsibilities Work directly with the Head of Product on research, analysis and product operations. Research publicly available iGaming products, features and user experiences. Compare registration, onboarding, payments, promotions, loyalty and gameplay journeys. Document findings using screenshots, structured notes and comparison tables. Turn research into short, practical recommendations. Use AI coding tools to create prototypes and demonstrate ideas. Build small internal tools, dashboards, data collectors and workflow automations. Test websites, prototypes and internal tools across desktop and mobile. Investigate product questions using spreadsheets, analytics and available data. Prepare briefs and organise tasks for designers, developers and other teams. Review completed work against the original brief and document any problems. Organise research, meeting notes, decisions and follow-up actions. Monitor relevant developments across iGaming, payments, digital products and AI. Requirements A recent graduate or someone with up to two years of professional experience. Experience with vibe coding or AI-assisted development. At least one personal, university or experimental project you can show us that you built using AI coding tools. Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Codex, Lovable, Replit or similar tools. The ability to turn an idea into a basic working website, prototype, automation or internal tool. Curiosity about how digital products and businesses work. Strong attention to detail when testing websites and reviewing information. Clear written communication and an ability to summarise research concisely. Comfort using spreadsheets and organising structured information. The initiative to investigate a problem independently before asking for instructions. Good judgement about when AI-generated work is incomplete, inaccurate or poorly designed. An interest in iGaming, online products, payments, fintech or gaming. Based in Malta or willing to relocate. Useful, But Not Essential Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL or APIs. Experience with analytics, automation, scraping or data visualisation. Familiarity with iGaming products or online payments. Experience with ClickUp, Figma or other product-management tools. A degree in business, technology, economics, information systems, marketing or a related subject. Why Join Paradise Media Work directly with an experienced product leader. Get broad exposure to product, AI, research, analytics and iGaming. Use modern AI tools as a normal part of your work. Build prototypes and tools rather than only writing reports. Take on meaningful responsibility early in your career. Develop towards a Product Analyst, Product Manager or AI Product Operations role. Work from our Balluta Bay office, with panoramic sea views, a private gym, massage chairs and collaborative workspaces. Application Requirement Please include a link, screenshots or a short demonstration of something you built using AI coding tools. It can be a personal, university or experimental project. Tell us what you built, why you built it, which tools you used, what you personally contributed and what went wrong before you got it working.

review_candidates.title: Satellite Payload Manager
review_candidates.description: We're Hiring: Satellite Payload Manager Location: United Arab Emirates (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior Work Arrangement: Fully Remote About Us We are a globally focused space organization committed to developing, integrating, and operating advanced satellite systems and mission payloads across diverse commercial, scientific, communications, Earth observation, and government applications. Our teams bring together spacecraft engineering, payload engineering, systems engineering, mission operations, ground systems, data processing, manufacturing, testing, and commercial expertise to deliver reliable payload capabilities throughout the mission lifecycle. The Role We are seeking an experienced Satellite Payload Manager to lead the technical strategy, development, integration, testing, qualification, delivery, and operational performance of satellite payloads. The ideal candidate will coordinate multidisciplinary payload teams and ensure payloads meet mission objectives, technical requirements, performance targets, interface requirements, regulatory obligations, and operational expectations from concept through launch and in-orbit commissioning. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement satellite payload strategies, technical roadmaps, development plans, and lifecycle processes. Lead payload development activities from mission definition and preliminary design through qualification, integration, launch, commissioning, and operations. Translate mission objectives into clear payload requirements, performance targets, interfaces, and verification criteria. Define payload architectures, functional concepts, operating modes, and technical configurations. Coordinate payload engineering across RF, optical, electronic, mechanical, thermal, software, data, and systems disciplines as applicable. Manage payload requirements, specifications, interface definitions, technical baselines, and verification matrices. Coordinate payload interfaces with spacecraft structures, power, thermal control, avionics, communications, attitude control, propulsion, and ground systems. Establish and maintain mechanical, electrical, thermal, RF, optical, data, software, and operational payload interfaces. Lead payload design reviews including concept reviews, preliminary design reviews, critical design reviews, test readiness reviews, and acceptance reviews. Manage payload development schedules, milestones, technical deliverables, resources, risks, and budgets. Coordinate payload modeling, simulation, analysis, prototyping, breadboarding, and engineering development activities. Oversee payload performance analysis and ensure compliance with mission-level requirements. Coordinate payload development for communications, Earth observation, remote sensing, scientific, navigation, hosted, or other mission-specific applications. Manage payload RF chains, antennas, transmitters, receivers, filters, amplifiers, digital processing, optical assemblies, detectors, sensors, or other mission-specific technologies where applicable. Coordinate payload electronics, digital processing, data handling, timing, control, and onboard software interfaces. Establish payload operating modes, command structures, telemetry requirements, data products, and operational concepts. Lead payload integration with spacecraft avionics and onboard data-handling systems. Coordinate payload-to-ground-system interfaces and end-to-end data flows. Develop payload integration and test strategies covering component, subsystem, payload, spacecraft, ground, and end-to-end mission levels. Review and approve payload test plans, procedures, specifications, and acceptance criteria. Coordinate functional, performance, environmental, qualification, acceptance, and calibration testing. Support thermal vacuum, vibration, acoustic, electromagnetic compatibility, radiation, optical, RF, and other mission-specific testing. Establish payload performance budgets including link budgets, power budgets, data-rate budgets, thermal budgets, optical budgets, sensitivity, resolution, coverage, or other applicable metrics. Monitor payload performance against allocated requirements and identify performance gaps. Lead payload calibration, characterization, alignment, tuning, and performance-validation activities. Coordinate payload ground-support equipment, test equipment, instrumentation, simulators, and specialized facilities. Manage payload anomalies, test discrepancies, nonconformances, and technical issues through investigation and closure. Lead root-cause analysis for payload failures, unexpected performance, interface problems, and test anomalies. Develop corrective and preventive actions and verify their effectiveness. Maintain configuration control of payload hardware, software, firmware, documentation, test configurations, and performance baselines. Evaluate engineering changes and assess impacts on payload performance, interfaces, schedule, certification, and mission objectives. Coordinate payload integration into the spacecraft and support spacecraft-level integration and testing. Support launch campaign activities and ensure payload readiness for transportation, launch-site processing, and final integration. Coordinate payload-to-launch-vehicle requirements and assess potential launch-environment impacts. Support payload commissioning activities following launch, including activation, functional checks, calibration, and initial performance characterization. Work with mission operations teams to develop payload operational procedures, command sequences, monitoring requirements, and contingency responses. Monitor in-orbit payload performance and coordinate investigation of performance deviations or anomalies. Support payload health monitoring, performance trending, predictive analysis, and operational optimization. Coordinate payload data validation, processing, quality assessment, archiving, and delivery requirements. Work with commercial, scientific, government, or customer teams to translate mission objectives into payload performance and data requirements. Manage payload suppliers, technology partners, specialist contractors, laboratories, and external engineering organizations. Review supplier technical proposals, designs, qualification evidence, test results, and performance documentation. Monitor supplier technical performance, schedule, quality, cost, risks, and corrective actions. Ensure payload development and operations comply with applicable space, spectrum, export-control, safety, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements. Support frequency coordination, licensing, spectrum-management, and regulatory activities where relevant to the payload mission. Identify emerging payload technologies and assess opportunities for improved performance, miniaturization, efficiency, data quality, or mission capability. Evaluate advanced sensors, onboard processing, AI-enabled payload functions, software-defined payloads, digital beamforming, optical communications, hyperspectral technologies, and other emerging capabilities where applicable. Develop payload technology and obsolescence-management strategies. Establish payload lifecycle plans covering upgrades, sustainment, spares, technical support, and end-of-life considerations. Mentor payload engineers, technical specialists, test engineers, and mission-support personnel. Provide senior management with regular reports covering payload development, performance, risks, testing, integration, costs, schedule, and mission readiness. Key Performance Indicators Payload development schedule adherence Payload requirements completion Requirements traceability coverage Payload design maturity Payload performance against requirements Payload mass and power performance Payload data-rate performance Payload sensitivity and accuracy Resolution or detection performance where applicable Payload availability Payload reliability Payload functional test pass rate Payload qualification completion Payload acceptance-test completion Environmental test performance Calibration accuracy Payload integration readiness Interface issue closure rate Payload anomaly rate Ideal Candidate The successful candidate should have strong experience in satellite payload engineering, spacecraft systems, payload development, space electronics, RF systems, optical payloads, Earth observation, communications satellites, scientific instruments, or mission operations , preferably within commercial space, satellite manufacturing, government space programs, defense, or advanced aerospace environments. The candidate should demonstrate: Strong understanding of satellite payload architectures and spacecraft interfaces. Experience managing payload development, integration, testing, and operational readiness. Strong knowledge of payload requirements, performance budgets, verification, and validation. Experience with one or more payload domains such as communications, RF, optical, Earth observation, remote sensing, scientific instrumentation, or navigation. Strong understanding of payload mechanical, electrical, thermal, data, RF, optical, and software interfaces. Experience with payload-level and spacecraft-level integration and testing. Knowledge of environmental qualification and acceptance testing for space hardware. Experience with payload calibration, characterization, performance validation, and anomaly resolution. Strong understanding of spacecraft power, thermal, avionics, data-handling, and attitude-control interfaces. Experience with payload ground-support equipment, test systems, instrumentation, and simulators. Familiarity with satellite ground systems, mission operations, telemetry, command, and data-processing environments. Experience managing technical suppliers, laboratories, specialist contractors, and technology partners.

review_candidates.description: Location: Barcelona (Hybrid) Type: Full-time Get to know us Started in 2016, Frekuent is now the all-in-one payment and loyalty platform for unattended environments — 500+ clients, 100M+ transactions a year, 2.5M+ users across Spain, France, Italy, Portugal, and Singapore. Why this role exists As our SMB sales & account management team keeps growing, the back office needs someone dedicated to keeping it running — onboarding, CRM, documentation, tickets, and the day-to-day coordination between clients and internal teams — so the Team Lead and front-line reps can stay focused on selling and managing accounts. This is a first-role-in-sales kind of seat. You don't need to have done this before: you'll ramp up with close guidance from your Team Lead, learn how sales, operations and payments fit together from the inside, and build the foundations for a career in sales ops. What you'll actually do Support customer onboarding and activation — preparing contracts, documentation and data collection alongside your Team Lead Coordinate installations and follow-ups so new clients go live smoothly Keep CRM data clean, consistent and up to date across the pipeline Help Account Managers and Account Executives with day-to-day account requests Log and track incidents, escalate to the right team, and keep clients updated as issues get resolved Support billing adjustments and subscription changes under supervision Keep dashboards and reports current so the team always has visibility Help maintain playbooks, templates and internal documentation, flagging bottlenecks or recurring issues as you spot them What you bring 0–2 years of experience in sales ops, support, admin or a similar role — internships count, and we're just as interested in the right mindset as the résumé Organized and structured, with a natural instinct for process rather than just tasks Comfortable with spreadsheets; no prior CRM experience required, but you pick up new tools fast Strong attention to detail and a problem-solving streak Clear communicator, comfortable flagging issues or ideas to your Team Lead rather than sitting on them Fluent in Spanish or English, with at least an intermediate level in the other (written and spoken) Takes ownership of what's assigned to you and follows it through to the end Bonus points if you... Have some hands-on exposure to a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot or similar) Have supported a sales or account management team before, even as an internship Are comfortable using AI tools to speed up repetitive admin work Have brushed up against sales funnels involving KYC, installations or product customization How we work Fast, autonomous, low-bureaucracy. We measure output, not hours in a chair. Resilience means iterating until it works — not giving up early. What's In It For You 🌍 A hybrid model that works – Enjoy the energy of our office 3 days a week and the flexibility of working remotely the other 2. ⏰ Flexible schedule – because we trust you to own your time and your outcomes. 🍽️ Meal vouchers – Enjoy a monthly support of meal vouchers to make your workdays tastier. 🩺 Health & wellness – private health insurance and discounted gym memberships to keep both body and mind in top shape. 📚 Learning & development – English classes and role-specific training, because your growth is part of our journey. 🌴 23 days of paid time off – plus local holidays, because great ideas need space to rest. 🚀 A dynamic, fast-growing environment – where each day is unique and every idea counts. 🤝 A collaborative mindset – surrounded by people who genuinely enjoy building together. 🎉 Regular afterwork & teambuilding events – activities to relax, connect, and strengthen team bonds. If you're ready to jump into an exciting environment and make a real difference, this is the place for you.
